per_JVM_medians: 48 update samples per JVM, excluding baseline/session-end
aggregate_ratios: median of three per-repetition ratios of per-JVM medians; ratio of reported aggregate phase medians need not equal reported aggregate ratio
clean_observation: full authority capture only, no journal projection or trace construction
shadow_observation: projection, full authority capture, equality validation, trace construction, profiling; no work disabled
